audit.whatIsWrong: Content gave Akali all seven rows while the full layer read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Veigar/Veigar, and Akali wins only 47.52% of 2140 games — the packet flags the contradiction.
audit.why: Both halves are half right. Veigar is immobile with a 20-second stun at rank 1, so Akali genuinely owns levels 1 through 5. Phenomenal Evil grants permanent AP off every champion hit, takedown and Baleful Strike kill, so the lane gets worse for her every wave — which is where a sub-50% win rate comes from.
audit.corrected: Akali levels 1-5, Skill at 6, Veigar from first item onward — proposed on both layers as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike text treated level 6 as still Akali's window and never named Veigar's real spike.
audit.why: Veigar's spike is not a level, it is a stack count. Phenomenal Evil compounds permanently, so his first item is worth more than hers and the crossover sits there. Level 6 is even because Primordial Burst is targeted and the shroud cancels it.
audit.corrected: Level 6 even on the shroud interaction; first item and two items are his on stacking.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primordial Burst is called an 'execute' with a 'threshold' in four places, and the two dash interactions with Event Horizon are never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.' That is missing-health scaling, not a threshold execute — the practical difference is that topping up your health reduces it rather than crossing a line. Two interactions were missing entirely: it is a TARGETED 650-range spell, so Twilight Shroud (unable to be selected by enemy spells) cancels it outright; and both Akali entry tools — the E recast and both casts of Perfect Execution — are dashes that eat the cage edge.
audit.corrected: Shroud denies Primordial Burst. Enter through the cage gap on foot; never dash the wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers; the advice said to commit on the cage's cooldown without saying how long that is.
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20/18.5/17/15.5/14 — a genuinely enormous window against an immobile champion, and the single most actionable number in the matchup.
audit.corrected: 20 seconds at rank 1 with no mobility to cover it.

audit.why: Both packet suspect names are false positives: 'Event Horizon's' is the correct name possessive, and 'Your Perfect Execution' is Akali's own R.

notes: Second packet-flagged chart contradiction: content gave Akali 7/7 at a 47.52% win rate while the full layer read Skill x5 then Veigar x2 — all seven rows disagreed. Resolved to Akali 1-5, Skill at 6, Veigar at first item and beyond, proposed as matched pairs (win[0] is included as an identity pair so the chart group is complete; drop it if the applier rejects a no-op). Killed the recurring 'Primordial Burst execute threshold' — it scales with missing health, which changes the advice from 'stay above a line' to 'stay topped up'. Added the two interactions the matchup actually turns on and which appeared nowhere: the shroud makes Akali unselectable so Primordial Burst cannot be cast at all, and BOTH of her entry tools are dashes that the cage edge stuns. Both packet suspect names are false positives. I did NOT touch phases[N].rating here: in this file the numbers rise toward the Veigar rows (5,5,5,5,6,7,8) while in akali's sylas and syndra entries the numbers rise toward the AKALI rows, so the two files use the scale in opposite directions and I could not tell which is intended — question raised.
